command: $dir='C:\Temp\weftmate-eval-action-02-web-document-2YnLMK'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; foreach ($v in 'v24.0.0','v22.0.0') { $u="https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/$v"; $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 40; $p=Join-Path $dir "$v.html"; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$r.Content); "$v saved LEN $($r.Content.Length)" }
description: Download Node 24 and 22 release notes HTML
